description: This file defines a service module for handling combo-related data in a grocery shopping web application. It includes functions to fetch combo data from a backend API with fallbacks to mock data, compute totals and availability for combos, and expose these functionalities for other parts of the application.

methods.name: tryFetch(url, options = {})
methods.description: A utility function to perform fetch requests with error handling and timeout detection.

methods.name: computeTotals(combo)
methods.description: Calculates total price, savings percentage, and availability status for a given combo object.

methods.name: listCombos()
methods.description: Fetches a list of combo objects from the backend API, falling back to mock data if needed, and enhances each combo with computed totals.

methods.name: getComboById(id)
methods.description: Retrieves a single combo by its ID from the backend API, or falls back to mock data, and computes derived totals and availability.
